svg.text: Solid wires trace metric ingestion, live PromQL reads, and alerting (steps 1-2, 4-6); dashed
wires mark 2h block flushes (3), compaction, rule sync, and the dead-man heartbeat.
Sharding ingestion by series label set lets each TSDB ingester append compressed
chunks sequentially in memory before flushing immutable blocks to object storage.
